data.name: MetaDescription
data.value: Where the Swiss inland navigation rules prohibit recreational diving: landing stages, ferry routes, harbours and moorings.

data.name: Eyebrow
data.value: Rules on the water

data.name: Title
data.value: Diving and shipping

data.name: Lead
data.value: At many sites, diving is only tolerated. If you know the rules, you help to keep it that way.

data.name: Forbidden_Title
data.value: Where recreational diving is prohibited

data.name: Forbidden_Intro
data.value: The Swiss Inland Navigation Ordinance (Art. 77 para. 3) prohibits recreational diving at these places:

data.name: Case_LandingStage
data.value: within 100 m of the authorised landing stages of scheduled boats;

data.name: Case_Routes
data.value: on the routes of scheduled boats;

data.name: Case_Harbour
data.value: at harbour entrances;

data.name: Case_Moorings
data.value: near authorised moorings, for example mooring fields;

data.name: Case_Fairway
data.value: in narrow fairways.

data.name: Case_Exception
data.value: The canton can reduce the distance around a landing stage (Art. 163). Cantonal and local rules also apply.

data.name: Behaviour_Title
data.value: How to behave

data.name: Behaviour_Flag
data.value: When you dive, show the flag «A» (white and blue), clearly visible on the shore or on the boat (Art. 32).

data.name: Behaviour_Distance
data.value: Boats keep at least 50 m away from this flag (Art. 49). Stay close to it.

data.name: Behaviour_Choose
data.value: Choose your entry and your route away from harbours, landing stages and mooring fields.

data.name: Behaviour_Local
data.value: Many local rules are not collected anywhere. If you dive at a site for the first time, ask a local club or dive shop first.

data.name: Map_Title
data.value: What the map shows

data.name: Map_LandingStage
data.value: Landing stages of scheduled boats with a circle of 100 m.

data.name: Map_Routes
data.value: Routes of scheduled boats as a dashed line.

data.name: Map_Harbour
data.value: Harbours as an area and mooring fields from the dive sketch, each with a circle of 50 m around the centre.

data.name: Map_Limits
data.value: Every distance is measured from the centre. Narrow fairways and moorings that are not recorded are not on the map. The map is for orientation only and is not legally binding.

data.name: Susv_Title
data.value: The SUSV

data.name: Susv_Text
data.value: The Swiss Underwater Sports Federation talks with the lake police and the shipping companies so that diving at the sites remains possible.

data.name: Susv_Link
data.value: To the SUSV
